Defeating targets builds stacks of Overcharge.

[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Swap firing modes when fully Overcharged.

In alternative firing mode, hold the trigger to charge up and fire more powerful linear fusion shots.

Defeating targets builds stacks of Overcharge.

[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Swap firing modes when fully Overcharged.

In alternative firing mode, hold the trigger to charge up and fire more powerful linear fusion shots.

Kills in Auto Rifle Mode grant Overcharge Stacks. Maximum of 6 Stacks. 

<link Tier 1 and 2 Minors, as well as Tier 1 Elites [#CombatantClassifications] /> grant 1 stack. All other enemy tiers and players grant 2 stacks.

Holding [Reload] overcharges this Fusion Rifle into a Linear Fusion Rifle. Grants three Hobgoblin-like shots that deal <pve 1417 /> <pvp [537] /> damage on Precision Hits and deal 200% increased damage against <link Champions [#CombatantClassifications] />.

Kills in Auto Rifle mode grant 'Overcharge' stacks. Maximum of 6 Stacks. 

<link Tier 1 and 2 Minors, as well as Tier 1 Elites [#CombatantClassifications] /> grant 1 stack. All other enemy tiers and players grant 2 stacks.

At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to change this Fusion Rifle into a Linear Fusion Rifle. Grants three Hobgoblin-like shots that deal <pve 1417 /> <pvp [537] /> precision damage and 200% increased damage against <link Champions [#CombatantClassifications] />.

Kills in Auto Rifle mode grant 'Overcharge' stacks. Maximum of 6 Stacks. 

<link Tier 1 and 2 Minors, as well as Tier 1 Elites [#CombatantClassifications] /> grant 1 stack. All other enemy tiers and players grant 2 stacks.

At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to change this Fusion Rifle into a Linear Fusion Rifle. Grants three Hobgoblin-like shots that deal <pve 1417 /> <pvp [537] /> precision damage and 200% increased damage against <link Champions [#CombatantClassifications] />. Stowing after activation removes all charged shots.

Precision Kills while in this mode trigger a <solar/>Solar Ignition. 

Upon leaving this mode, the magazine is refilled.
